item.text:
I found the fault in [collection.py](/app/lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:942). `_walk` follows internal directory symlinks and records their children. `_build_collection_tar` then passes resolved paths to `tarfile.add`, turning symlinks into regular entries. On install, `install_artifact` creates manifest directories with `mkdir` and `_extract_tar_file` writes file content without checking whether the tar member is a symlink. The tar helpers expose streams but discard the `TarInfo` needed for that check.

A fix should record each internal directory link once, preserve internal file and directory links with relative `linkname` values, copy external file targets as regular files, and validate resolved targets against the collection root before restoring links. External directory-link behavior needs a decision: [an existing test](/app/test/units/galaxy/test_collection.py:474) expects it to be skipped. Other [symlink tests](/app/test/units/galaxy/test_collection.py:492) assert the current expansion behavior.

I recorded the detailed findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). **No project source or tests were changed**: this run was constrained to fault localization. I did not run tests.
